notes.title: Released 0.2.0 - Wave Update & Event
notes.notes:
Big update 0.2.0 is now live!

https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ComplicatedEnviousDartfrog-size_restricted.gif
New

    New Impact visual on block drops!
    New combo system!
    New Wave effect on Editor!

General

    Added links on the main menu

Gameplay

    Now score UI flows

Editor

    Added confirmation UI before deleting a level

Bugfix

    After deleting a song and make a new one with the same title, the resources will pass on


Thanks to your support, version 0.2.0 is now live!
And to celebrate the update, we will be hosting our FIRST EVENT!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31191936/6077aeec0aec2999b451f823fb8348241c393b4a.png

For more information please sure to join the official Discord Server!
Click Here To Join!

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 is near!
notes.notes:
HYPE! New big update will be released on August 30th.

The game will feature new Wave Effect with enhanced game experience.
And Combo System is completely renewed for competitive leaderboard.
(The leaderboards will be reset upon the update)

https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ComplicatedEnviousDartfrog-size_restricted.gif

Also to celebrate, BEATris first Event will begin upon the update!
So stay tuned for more information ;)

notes.title: Released 0.1.9 - Major Bugfix & Optimization
notes.notes:
General

Optimized audio loading

Bugfix

Fixed loading wrong audio when quick selecting through levels


Major bug has been fixed! The game has been through a big surgery, though you won't notice the change :(

And we would like to introduce the artist behind our mascot, Gashi-gashi! It's been great working with the artist and we are eager to work with him again when we have the chance. If you like the character design you should definitely checkout his website. 
Gashi-gashi's DeviantArt

Also, we are looking forward to your direct feedbacks! Pitch your ideas and we will look through it ;) 
Go To Ideas & Suggestions Forum

notes.title: Released 0.1.6 - Leaderboard Update!
notes.notes:
General

Added "Leaderboard" system


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31191936/96255edf43a7c606b6cbeb3605cf2e93538cd11f.png

Now leaderboard system is live! Check out your rank and compete with others to the top. The key to getting high score is to achieve high combos as much as you can.
Also, if you have any questions about the editor or want to share awesome techniques on level making, try using workshop forum! We will gladly be there for your service.

Go To Workshop Forum

notes.title: 0.1.3 Released - Editor Bugfix
notes.notes:
BugfixFixed music speed not resetting after changed in EditorFixed UI error when new level is loaded in EditorFixed UI error which playbar doesn't update when music is paused in Editor

As always, thank you for your support! Currently we are focusing on making decent levels and adding advanced options such as key bindings.
Also, we are aware of the bug where snapping notes is inconsistent in Editor, but it seems the problem was in the game engine (Unity3D) and has been disappeared after the engine's update.If you were to find the bug again, please let us know in the comments or "Bug Reports" forum.

notes.title: 0.1.2 Released - Editor Update & Resolution Fix
notes.notes:

 Added build tracker on main menu
 Disabled a hidden debug key

Editor

notes.title: Early Access release on November 30th!
notes.notes:
Coming Soon! 
BEATris scheduled launch date is November 30th.
That's less than 2 weeks! Buckle up for brand new experience!
Make sure to add the game on your wishlist or follow us for future updates.  

 Why Early Access? 
BEATris was able to come to life thanks to one person's passion on rhythm genre and with the help of many others. It is safe to say that BEATris will give you a fresh fun gameplay, however we cannot guarantee the best experience on current state. We believe the help of community is more needed than just one developer's mind in this genre. That is the reason why BEATris will be launched in Early Access. We hope to communicate with the community as much as possible and develop the game on its full potential together. Our team is always eager to support the players.

 Follow Us!
